name: puffermedia-bsbasic
description: Assets used by the puffermedia-bsbasic site template.

assets.name: tpl.bsbasic.user
assets.description: Optional client overrides. Loaded only when css/user.css exists; never shipped in the package.

assets.name: tpl.bsbasic.sticky
assets.description: Sticky header behaviour (loaded only when the Sticky Header param is on).

assets.name: tpl.bsbasic.sidebarmenu
assets.description: Collapsible sidebar menu behaviour (loaded only when the Sidebar Menu param is Collapsible).

assets.name: tpl.bsbasic.animate
assets.description: Scroll-in entrance animations for cards and sections (loaded only when the Entrance Animation param is not None).

assets.name: tpl.bsbasic.backtotop
assets.description: Back-to-top button behaviour (loaded only when the Back-to-Top param is on).
